chapterFiles.title: Ma Vie Jusqu’à La Première Rencontre

subtitles.en: Raël's 1975 account of his journey to the Elohim's planet

descriptions.en: Raël's 1975 record of his second encounter with the *Elohim* and his subsequent journey to their home planet, where he was shown the laboratories, technology, and society of the civilization that engineered life on Earth. Continues the framework of *The Book Which Tells the Truth* with interstellar travel, the Council of the Eternals, and a long teaching session ('Les Clés') that lays out the practical philosophy underpinning Raëlism.
